name: sales-ae-pro
description: Enterprise AE toolkit for B2B technology sales. Covers the full deal cycle: prospect research, call prep, post-meeting processing, pipeline hygiene, outreach generation, business case building, and presentation coaching.
author: beckwith930-star

commands.name: ae:prospect
commands.description: Full prospect research: company brief, ICP fit, leadership contacts, news, competitive landscape, facility footprint

commands.name: ae:call-prep
commands.description: Pre-call package: CRM brief, discovery questions mapped to qualification gates, talk track, objections

commands.name: ae:post-meeting
commands.description: Salesforce note, internal leadership briefing, follow-up email, qualification checklist update

commands.name: ae:pipeline
commands.description: Stale deal flags, qualification gap matrix, weighted pipeline, prioritized action list

commands.name: ae:outreach
commands.description: Cold email, LinkedIn connection + follow-up, phone talk track, 3-week cadence plan

commands.name: ae:deck-review
commands.description: TED framework scoring, weak slide identification, specific improvement recommendations

commands.name: ae:business-case
commands.description: Internal business case from public data: exec summary, pain mapping, opportunity sizing, pilot playbook

commands.name: ae:qbr
commands.description: Full QBR deck outline and narrative with coaching feedback
